title: aster lasiocarpus
intro: Aster lasiocarpus, commonly known as prairie aster or purple prairie clover, is a perennial wildflower native to the prairies of North America. It is a member of the aster family and is valued for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The health benefits of Aster lasiocarpus include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities.
